caps.rule: never skipped: the ager keeps the newest cards of a pool over its cap (the oldest go, hrFxQ serial)

switches.keep_on / keep_off: cards made between carry rlk_hr_fx_keep: fx/clear (pause, death_start, the ager's dead / revive clear) leaves them; the module cleanup and fx/uninstall remove them
switches.follow_on / follow_off: @s = the lead: cards made between follow it every tick (its x / z, their own height over it)

conventions.yaw: + = to the executor's right (offset from its rotation)
conventions.roll: about the aim (qi_arc 0 flat / 90 vertical); qi_band: lean (+ = top forward); scarlet_line: + lifts the + (right) end
conventions.units: tenths of a block / degrees / ticks

qi_arc.doc: A sword-qi crescent of reach {r} (tenths) about the executor (S3: the body + 1.0, rotated as the body; S4: the cut spot + h, rotated as the player; S2b: at her): {yaw} / {pitch} the aim's offsets from the executor rotation (yaw + = right, pitch + = up), {roll} the blade: |roll| < 20 (or > 160) a flat crescent rolled about the aim; |roll| 20..160 (a slanted slash) the crescent stands across the aim, rolled by roll in that plane (the screen plane of a viewer behind the target: F2, HR-12), centred on the executor. Four sweep frames 1 t apart (the last fades over 6 t): the lilac body, the white-pink cutting rim; c tints it (1 lilac .. 5 white). A crescent that would reach below the floor rises up to 1 b, then shrinks (fx/e/clamp_arc): no frame below the floor.

qi_ring.doc: A flat sword-qi ring of radius {r} (tenths) about the executor (S3: the body + 0.8 / 1.55; S4: the cut spot + 0.8 / 0.1; the vanish: the body + 0.8), horizontal: the lilac ring spreading and turning, a white-pink rim ring behind it, particles round its edge; c tints it.

qi_band.doc: A broad sword-qi band of length {len} (tenths) across the aim, centred on the executor (S4 A8.2: the cut spot + 0.3, rotated as the player; S2b CS4 E1b: her + 1.1 facing the player): an upright sheet whose long axis runs to the aim's left and right, rising by {pitch} degrees toward its right end, {roll} leaning its top forward; {yaw} turns the aim. It sweeps {sw} (tenths; F2, HR-32: A8.2 25, CS4 E1b her distance + 1 b) forward along the aim over 6 t (its leading streak 4 % further) and fades (lilac, the white-pink upper rim). Near the floor it rises (fx/e/clamp_band) so no part of it reaches below the floor; under a lean the sweep stays level.

qi_x.doc: The X of two crossed sword-qi slashes of reach {r} (tenths) lying flat at the executor (S4 A8.5: the cut spot + 0.1, rotated as the player: a hit effect at the contact tick, never shown before it): two flattened crescents at +-45 deg crossing on the executor, lilac.

qi_dome.doc: A8.7 the spin dome of radius {r} (tenths) at the executor (S4: the cut spot on the floor): the white-pink rim ring at waist height (+0.9 b) turning out, and a translucent lilac dome that expands from the floor to radius r, turns into a thin white outline and fades.

qi_vert.doc: A vertical sword-qi crescent of height {h} (tenths) standing on the executor (S3 A3: the body + 0.15, ahead; S4 A8.8: beside the cut spot on the floor, rotated as the player): F2 (HR-12) the crescent stands ACROSS the aim (yaw 0 = the plane perpendicular to the executor's facing, its arc bulging to the executor's right; 180 = to its left; {yaw} turns the plane), from the executor up to h, the sweep rising (four frames), and a thin glowing upright line at its foot facing the viewer; c tints it (A8.8: 2 magenta). Level: the executor's pitch is ignored.

qi_fan.doc: A rising vertical fan of sword-qi of height {h} (tenths) centred on the executor (S3 A1: h 16 at the body + 1.1, 1.2 b ahead; cosmetic): F2 (HR-12) the four sweep frames stand ACROSS the executor's facing (the plane perpendicular to it), bulging to its left (the right of a viewer facing it), rising; c tints it (A1: 2). Level.

qi_wedge.doc: A sword-qi wedge of length {r} (tenths) from the executor (S3 A3 h5: the body + 1.0; S4 A7: the body + 0.85), {roll} degrees: F2 (HR-12) |roll| 20..160 = the wedge stands across the facing, its point up and rolled by roll in that plane (the rising diagonal a viewer behind the target sees broadside); else it lies along the facing, rolled about it: a lilac spearhead widening behind its point, white edges; particles at the point. Level.

qi_ribbon.doc: A4 the sword-qi ribbon wrapping round her (S3: the body + 1.0): three lilac ribbon strips tilted at different angles turning round her (one fading), lilac motes swirling.

qi_line.doc: A thin straight sword-qi line of length {len} (tenths) from the executor, F2 (HR-12) ACROSS its facing: the facing turned 90 deg to its right, its pitch kept (S3 A5: from her left, the body + 0.95, 1.5 b ahead, level: a horizontal slash across the view; S4 A8.9 the dive line: her + 0.8, rotated ~ 90 = straight down, unchanged): a white core inside a lilac glow; a line pointing down is clamped to end above the floor.

qi_cut.doc: A9 the iai cut along the dash: a long pink-magenta slash line of length {len} (tenths) from the executor along its yaw (S3: the dash start + 0.8, rotated along the dash), a white-hot core, magenta sparks along it.

glint.doc: A blade glint at the executor (the blade_tip / hat_crown / chest anchors): a four-ray sparkle flaring and turning, a smaller one crossing it; c tints it (1 lilac, 2 pink-magenta, 3 yellow, 4 crimson, 5 white).

star4.doc: A9 the four-point star in a thin circle at her chest (the chest anchor, facing the viewer, 1.3 b): lilac, a white glint inside, for 6 t.

yellow_tell.doc: The yellow tell for {t} ticks at the executor (S3 A9 / A10: the body + 1.0, in the air for A10; S4 A7: her): the yellow sphere (1.6 b) and the horizontal flare line through it (4 b), yellow motes.

ghost_burst.doc: The lilac switch / the vanish (the body + 0.8-1.1): the body bursts into lilac-white mist (four puffs flung out), white-lilac ribbons tracing the silhouette rise, sparkles linger to 12 t.

ghost_trail.doc: A ghost dash / glide / run (S4: the body + 0.45-0.95, rotated toward its target, at the move's start): a lilac flame trail and white speed lines along the aim over {len} (tenths), drawn out over 4 t as she passes, fading after 12 t; lilac motes along it.

ghost_flash.doc: D3 the flash-blink (the body + 0.95): a white-violet electric flash, sparks.

afterimage.doc: One translucent lilac silhouette of her at the executor (S3: the body + 1.2; S2b: her feet: the card stands 1.2 b below the executor, never below the floor), turned to the viewer, fading over 6 t (at most 4 alive: the ager removes the oldest), and a lilac streak of {len} (tenths) behind her along her facing.

blink_bubble.doc: A6 the back-blink (the body + 1.0): a pale blue-white translucent bubble swelling and gone, white motes.

shield_refill.doc: The lead-ins' refill beat (at her, the body + 1.1): eight lilac crystal shards fly in to her and a flash closes them, a thin rim ring.

pip_break.doc: A pip removed (at the player's chest): lilac shards burst out, a white flash, amethyst chips, sparks.

dive_impact.doc: A dive landing of radius {r} (tenths) at the executor (S3 A4: the lock + 0.1; S4 the A8 fail: the impact point): a flat lilac shock ring with radial spikes spreading (a hit effect at the contact tick), the rim ring, a white flash, lilac dust and sparks.

light_column.doc: A lilac light column from the executor (the player's spot on the floor: the deflect, the A8 fail) up 9 b: two crossed glowing quads widening, a white core, motes rising. Upright whatever the executor's pitch (F2, HR-41: both cards at pitch 0).

claw_streaks.doc: A10 the claw streaks (the lock spot + 2.0): four lilac claw-like streaks inside radius {r} (tenths) fall from 5 b above the executor onto it in 2 t (their points ending at the executor), then fade.

burst_radial.doc: A10 the landing burst of radius {r} (tenths) at the executor (the lock + 0.1): the lilac shock ring turning the other way, six claw streaks flung out radially, motes rising.

dust_ring.doc: CS2 R6 the dust ring of radius {r} (tenths) where she lands on her back (at her feet + 0.1): ground chips in a ring of eight puffs, a soft cloud, grey dust (particles only).

kick_flash.doc: CS2 / CS3 R8 the kick on her head (the head anchor): the cyan-gold impact flash (the only cyan-gold flash), a white glint, sparks.

clash_gold.doc: Blade on blade (the blade_mid / hat_crown anchors, the midpoint between them; the deflect at the player): the gold starburst, six gold sparks flung out, crits.

clash_spark.doc: A small blade spark (the blade_mid / blade_tip anchors, every few ticks of a blade lock): four gold-white spark streaks, pink-violet embers.

clash_arc.doc: CS1 C1 the orange lightning arcs between her blade and the player (the blade_mid anchor, every 2 t): two jagged arcs facing the viewer, orange dust.

deco_bolt.doc: A decoration bolt (the gauntlets' thin yellow lightning; no hit box) standing on the executor (a floor spot 3-6 b from the player) up 7 b: two flickering bolts, sparks.

scarlet_line.doc: 홍련일섬's red slash line (CS1 C8, the 5 % instant death; S2b: the player's chest point, facing her): a line of length {len} (tenths) through the executor along the executor's yaw + {yaw} (90 = across a viewer looking along the executor's facing, its + end on their right), roll > 0 rises toward the player's right: CS1 C8 / the 5 % instant death: +13 deg; it opens in 2 t, darkens after 12 t, closes by 30 t. Floor-safe at any height and roll (F2, HR-44): when its low end would dip under 0.25 b over the floor it slides along its own length toward its high end (fx/e/clamp_sline), so it still crosses the executor point and stops just above the floor.

petal_burst.doc: A burst of petals of radius {r} (tenths) at the executor (CS1 C8 at her, CS2 R7, the 5 % instant death at the player): eight pink petals flung out turning, cherry leaves, pink dust.

petals_drift.doc: CS0 E8 the petals drifting across the field as she sweeps her hand (at her chest, rotated as her): six pink petals drifting slowly to her right and down, turning, for 40 t; cherry leaves (ambient pool).

petals_wind.doc: CS4 S4 thin petal streaks in the wind (at her + 0.8, rotated as her): petals and two thin pink streaks whipping across from her left to her right (ambient pool).

petals_heart.doc: CS4 big pink heart-shaped petals crossing near her (at her chest, rotated as her): three slow, turning heart petals for 30 t (ambient pool), cherry leaves.

motes_warm.doc: CS4 warm firefly-like motes low over the grass (at her + 0.4): five small warm motes rising slowly for 40 t (ambient pool), fireflies.

leaves_dark.doc: Dark-red / black leaves blowing across the sky (S2b CS1: her + 6, rotated as her): {n} leaves (up to 40; n < 0: the last -n of them, so {n:20} and then {n:-20} spread the 40 over two ticks) from her left across to her right over 30 t, turning (ambient pool).

leaves_swirl.doc: Dark-red leaves swirling round her (CS1 C8 / SQ1: her + 1.1): ten leaves flung round and up, turning, dark-red dust (ambient pool).

ambient_p1.doc: Arena ambience, P1 (the module, every ~10 t near the player; at the player): a pink petal drifting down (ambient pool), cherry leaves, one dark ash speck further out (arena.md §5: sparse).

ambient_p2.doc: Arena ambience, P2 (the module, every ~6 t near the player; at the player): crimson spores, a pink mote, a firefly low over the grass about every 20 t (particles only).

arrive_rift.doc: The arrival tear (S2b CS0 E0: the floor point 1.5 b behind the player, facing the arena): the dungeon rift's void, rim and four lightning arcs (the rlk:rift models of tools/build_rift.py when the pack has them) shrink shut over 30 t, portal motes.

ev_glint.doc: E12 the glint running along the scabbard (S2b: at the hand_r anchor): three small white glints along her facing 0 / 0.4 / 0.8 b, 2 t apart, end-rod motes (the fight kit's blade glint).

ev_trail.doc: The thrown sword's trail (each flight tick, at the sword): 2 cherry leaves + 1 lilac mote.

ev_petals.doc: Petals round the point (E56-E108 round the player every 4 t): {n} cherry leaves + {n} petal motes (#D55D87).

ev_leave.doc: E34 she leaves in petals and wind (at her chest): 60 cherry leaves + 30 petal motes + a gust, spread 0.5 / 0.95 / 0.5.

ev_beam.doc: A silver moonbeam (E44 onto the sword / E42 onto the player): a column from {h} (tenths) above the executor down to it, drawn over {t} ticks by the ager (a marker the kit ages): end rods + silver dust at the falling front, silver dust along the lit column, a flash at the point when it arrives.

ev_wind.doc: E42 the wind round the player: a 16-point ring of small white dust of radius {r} (tenths), a gust, 6 cherry leaves.

ev_palm.doc: The moonlight "cup" in her palm / the orb (every tick): 2 end rods + 3 silver motes at the point.

ev_take.doc: E56 the grant (at the player's chest): 20 end rods (speed 0.15) and a 16-point ring (r 1.2) of lilac (c 1, the item) or silver (c 2, the buff) dust.

disc.doc: A7 moon disc (R2, A13): one flat lilac disc card on the projectile display (radius 1.4 = the hazard's half width), horizontal, spinning 30 deg per tick (quarter turns over 3 t), facing its flight (the display's yaw).

petal_big.doc: CS1 the big red petal (0.8 b, the caller turns it to face the player each tick; it rocks slowly): {look} whole / cut (a glowing line across) / split (the halves apart).

moon_halo.doc: The halo card 1 b in front of the block moon (12.4 b, facing the arena as the caller turned it; its centre clear, the block disc shows through): {look} p1 white-blue / p2 red / off (hidden) / p1b, p2b = p1, p2 about 20 % brighter (CS0 E3, the CS4 moon gaze).

lotus.doc: A lotus flower on the pond (the water surface; 0.9 b, standing, turning to the viewer): {look} bud (closed, pale pink, P1) / bloom (open crimson, P2).

seat_rock.doc: CS0 her seat: a low flat stone (vanilla tuff, 1.2 x 0.24 x 0.64 b, its top 0.24 b over the display (under her thighs, behind her heels): no collision) and on it {look}: bottle = the rice-wine bottle on her left, bare = the stone alone, set = the bottle and the cup on her right (vanilla item displays the kit keeps with the stone: bare drops them at once, a killed stone's go within 10 t; the module re-looks it bare before it kills it).

1.text: 꽃 속에 술 한 병 놓고,

5.text: 그리고 이제 친구가 와 주었으니 월하독작이 아니라, 대작이 되겠구만.

7.text: 곧 또 보게 될 것 같다고.

9.text: 신세진 것도 있겠다, 이 달 아래서...

20.text: 다음 번에 만나면, 그땐 같이 한잔 하면 좋을 텐데...

22.text: 어디 보자, 낭자네에선 이렇게 인사한다고 들었는데...

24.text: 조심하게. 칼자루를 쥐었다고 그 검의 주인이 되는 것은 아니니.

pages.text: 그 검의 주인이 되는 것은 아니니.
